One-paragraph essence, self-check items.
examShortTricks: Trick 1: Unit questions test argument evaluation — find the writer's CLAIM, the EVIDENCE and the ASSUMPTION; a missing-evidence comment earns the analysis mark.
Trick 2: For 'do you agree?' items, use the 3-step reply: concede one point, refute with evidence, restate your position.
practiceQuestions: Q. What assumption does the writer's argument rest on? (2 marks) — identify the unstated premise and explain how the claim depends on it.
Q. Give one counter-argument to the writer's claim. (2 marks) — state it fairly, then say why it is weaker.
keyPoints: Question assumptions before accepting claims — apply this to the unit's own readings.
Distinguish fact, opinion and belief in any passage; examiners test this directly.
